trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life
neutral_facts: The accused, who were the son and associates of the deceased, were implicated in the death of the deceased, who was found dead by his brother. The prosecution alleged that the accused had a property dispute with the deceased and that the accused fled the scene. The accused were apprehended, and items such as a rusted iron rod and a sweater were recovered. The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence, including witness testimonies about the accused's presence at the scene and Call Detail Records (CDRs) to establish their location. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the IPC and sentenced them to life imprisonment. The High Court upheld the conviction, but the Supreme Court quashed the conviction, finding that the prosecution failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.
